title: Sneakers & Resale Collecting Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: StockX market prices (`stockx:price`), GOAT listings (`goat:listing`), Alias sales (`alias:sale`), sneaker rotation logs (`sneaker:rotation`), and deadstock age checks (`deadstock:age`).
app: StockX price alerts, GOAT listing exports, Alias seller settlement logs, sneaker rotation wear trackers, and deadstock age audits ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=deadstock:age) OR (index=personal sourcetype=stockx:price)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="deadstock:age","primary",sourcetype="stockx:price","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from deadstock:age and stockx:price to see whether two sneakers feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `deadstock:age` and `stockx:price` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main sneakers data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
